configSchema.help: A starting point — it fills in the colours below, which you can still change.

configSchema.help: Only teams you are a member of and their channels appear here.

configSchema.label: Seconds per message
configSchema.help: How long each message stays up in Spotlight.

name: Text
tagline: Show a message or announcement
description: Display a short message or announcement on your screens.

configSchema.label: Message
configSchema.help: Optional when a background image is set.

configSchema.label: Background image URL
configSchema.help: Optional. A full-screen background photo behind the text.

configSchema.label: Image overlay
configSchema.help: Darkens the background image so text stays readable.

name: Ticker
tagline: Scroll announcements across the screen
description: A moving band of short messages — news, notices, opening hours. Add a row per message.

configSchema.label: Show on screens
configSchema.help: The ticker stays visible over everything these screens play.

configSchema.label: Source
configSchema.help: Scroll your own messages, or live headlines from an RSS feed.

configSchema.label: Messages
configSchema.help: The messages to scroll. They repeat in order — drag to reorder.

configSchema.label: RSS feed URL
configSchema.help: Headlines from this feed scroll in the band and refresh automatically.

configSchema.label: Position
configSchema.help: Where the band sits on the screen.

configSchema.label: Theme
configSchema.help: A starting point — it fills in the colors below, which you can still change.

configSchema.label: Font size (%)
configSchema.help: 100% is the size the app was designed at. Go up or down from there — the text always scales with the screen.

name: Vimeo
tagline: Play a Vimeo video on your screens
description: Paste a Vimeo link and loop the video across your displays — no downloads, no fuss.

configSchema.label: Vimeo link
configSchema.help: Copy it from Vimeo's address bar, or from its Share button. One video per app.

name: Weather
tagline: Live local weather on your screens
description: Show the current weather and a short forecast for any city — updated automatically.

configSchema.label: Location
configSchema.help: Start typing and pick a place from the list. The forecast follows it.

configSchema.label: Layout
configSchema.help: How the weather is arranged on the screen.

options.label: At a glance — the temperature and the week
Hour by hour — how today unfolds
The week — seven days, warmest to coldest
Minimal — the temperature, and nothing else
Agency — a weather desk on the news

configSchema.label: Theme
configSchema.help: Weather: the screen takes its colours from the sky — blue in clear weather, grey in rain, dark at night.

configSchema.label: Language
configSchema.help: The language the weather is shown in on the screen. It doesn't change this page.

configSchema.label: Show the time
configSchema.help: A small clock in the corner. It also proves the screen is live rather than frozen.

tagline: Show any website or dashboard
description: Embed any web page or live dashboard on your screens by URL.

configSchema.label: Page address
configSchema.help: Not every site can be shown this way. Google, social networks and most banking sites refuse, and come up blank on screen — a page you own, or a dashboard’s public share link, works best.

name: Daily Wisdom
tagline: A new quote on the wall every day
description: Shows a handful of inspiring quotes, each one in a different design — refreshed on its own, every day.

configSchema.label: Topics
configSchema.help: What the quotes should be about. Pick a few — a gym might choose Motivation and Sports, a waiting room Health & wellness and Life.

configSchema.label: How many quotes
configSchema.help: How many quotes the screen cycles through before starting over.

configSchema.label: Seconds per quote
configSchema.help: How long each quote stays on the screen.

name: World clocks
tagline: The time in several places at once
description: Show the current time in multiple cities. One place per line as "Label | Zone".

configSchema.label: Places
configSchema.help: Add a place per row. The zone is an IANA name, e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo.

configSchema.label: Theme
configSchema.help: A starting point — it fills in the colours below, which you can still change.

configSchema.label: Accent colour
configSchema.help: The place labels.

configSchema.label: Font size (%)
configSchema.help: 100% is the size the app was designed at. Go up or down from there — the text always scales with the screen.

name: YouTube
tagline: Play a YouTube video on your screens
description: Paste a YouTube link and play the video across your displays — no downloads, no fuss.

configSchema.label: YouTube link
configSchema.help: Copy it from YouTube's address bar, or from its Share button. One video per app — playlists aren't supported.
